target_customer: Online telehealth and D2C health brands that want to recover abandoned checkouts and win back leads
problem: Abandoned checkout campaigns convert poorly and human follow up is slow, so high intent leads go cold.
business_model: B2B usage or subscription AI sales agents (calls, SMS, WhatsApp, email); free trial offered, pricing not public
product_category: AI sales agents for health and D2C commerce (HIPAA and SOC 2 positioned)

founders.name: Kristy Gao
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; a Waterloo alumni story also covers her path to YC.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and text agents with memory across channels and healthcare compliance are standard engineering on top of commodity models.

defensibility.rationale: HIPAA and SOC 2 reports are a mild barrier, but many vendors offer abandoned cart voice agents and the underlying models are shared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Messaging platforms and many voice agent startups serve abandoned checkout recovery. No evidence found of Cenote being copied or bought.

market_need_then: Abandoned checkout outreach converts poorly, which the company puts under 1% for traditional campaigns (self reported); it also cites a clinic customer whose agent converted at twice a human rep.

branding.domain_note: Uses joincenote.com with a join prefix rather than cenote.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and personal, taglines Every person, fully understood and Every lead, instantly engaged

branding.community_and_virality: Launches on Product Hunt in March 2025 and April 2026

brand_strength.rationale: Product Hunt launches and a Launch HN exist, but no source shows brand driven growth. A cenote is a natural sinkhole, which has no obvious tie to the product.

pivots.from: Back office automation and referral intake for medical clinics (Launch HN, March 2025)
pivots.to: AI sales reps for online health and D2C brands, abandoned checkout recovery
pivots.why: Not stated; the Product Hunt launch dated 2026-04-15 covers the sales agents

outcome_analysis: Cenote began in Winter 2025 as back office automation for medical clinics and has moved to AI sales agents for telehealth and D2C brands, citing customers such as BetterMe Rx. No funding round or exit is verified, so the outcome is unresolved and depends on competing against many abandoned checkout voice agents.
notes: Funding: only an aggregator mention of $500K total (one source), unverified and not recorded. The Launch HN post lists a third co-founder, Ajani Smith-Washington, but the YC page lists two, so he is omitted. Pivot date approximate. Competition at founding left empty: the abandoned checkout competitor sources found are undated or later than the batch. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (2025-03) rests on a single database (VCBacked); no press found.
